details.nl: Negozi a Bergamo
details.jcoql: GET COLLECTION negozi; FILTER CASE WHERE .city = 'Bergamo' KEEP OTHERS;

details.nl: Prodotti con prezzo maggiore di 50
details.jcoql: GET COLLECTION Prodotti; FILTER CASE WHERE .price > 50 KEEP OTHERS;

details.nl: Hotel con rating 5
details.jcoql: GET COLLECTION Hotel; FILTER CASE WHERE .rating = 5 KEEP OTHERS;

details.nl: Utenti con email
details.jcoql: GET COLLECTION users; FILTER CASE WHERE .email > '' KEEP OTHERS;

details.nl: Documenti senza note
details.jcoql: GET COLLECTION my_collection; FILTER CASE WHERE NOT .notes KEEP OTHERS;

details.nl: Hotel a Milano con rating superiore a 4 e prezzo inferiore a 200
details.jcoql: GET COLLECTION Hotels; FILTER CASE WHERE .city = 'Milano' AND .rating > 4 AND .price < 200 KEEP OTHERS;

details.nl: Ristoranti a Roma o Firenze
details.jcoql: GET COLLECTION restaurants; FILTER CASE WHERE .city = 'Roma' OR .city = 'Firenze' KEEP OTHERS;

details.nl: Prodotti con prezzo tra 100 e 500 euro
details.jcoql: GET COLLECTION products; FILTER CASE WHERE .price IN_RANGE [ 100 , 500 ] KEEP OTHERS;

details.nl: Appartamenti con superficie tra 50 e 100 metri quadri
details.jcoql: GET COLLECTION apartments; FILTER CASE WHERE .surface IN_RANGE [ 50 , 100 ] KEEP OTHERS;

details.nl: Ordini dove il campo note è null
details.jcoql: GET COLLECTION ordini; FILTER CASE WHERE .note = NULL KEEP OTHERS;

details.nl: Clienti dove descrizione non è null
details.jcoql: GET COLLECTION clienti; FILTER CASE WHERE NOT .description = NULL KEEP OTHERS;

details.nl: Prodotti senza email e senza telefono
details.jcoql: GET COLLECTION products; FILTER CASE WHERE (NOT .email = .email) AND (NOT .phone = .phone) KEEP OTHERS;

details.nl: Hotel a Milano o Roma con rating maggiore di 4 e prezzo minore di 300
details.jcoql: GET COLLECTION hotels; FILTER CASE WHERE (.city = 'Milano' OR .city = 'Roma') AND .rating > 4 AND .price < 300 KEEP OTHERS;

details.nl: Prodotti elettronici con prezzo tra 200 e 1000 e non discontinued
details.jcoql: GET COLLECTION elettronici; FILTER CASE WHERE .price IN_RANGE [ 200 , 1000 ] AND NOT .discontinued KEEP OTHERS;

details.nl: Clienti premium o gold che sono attivi
details.jcoql: GET COLLECTION clienti; FILTER CASE WHERE (.type = 'premium' OR .type = 'gold') AND .status = 'attivo' KEEP OTHERS;

details.nl: Temperature tra 18.5 e 22.5 gradi
details.jcoql:
GET COLLECTION temperatures_data;
FILTER CASE WHERE .temperature IN_RANGE [ 18.5 , 22.5 ] KEEP OTHERS;

details.nl: Vendite per categoria con totale maggiore di zero
details.jcoql: GET COLLECTION Sales; FILTER CASE WHERE .total > 0 KEEP OTHERS;

details.nl: Salva risultati come nuova collezione chiamata best_hotels
details.jcoql: GET COLLECTION hotels; FILTER CASE WHERE .rating >= 4.5 KEEP OTHERS; SAVE AS best_hotels;

details.nl: Unisci le collezioni clienti_europa e clienti_usa
details.jcoql: GET COLLECTION clienti_europa;

details.nl: Clienti comuni tra online e negozio
details.jcoql: GET COLLECTION customers; FILTER CASE WHERE .isOnline = true AND .isStore = true KEEP OTHERS;
